detail.summary: This notebook explores the intersection of computational self-verification (as seen in DeepSeekMath-V2) and Popperian falsification. We examine whether 'self-verification' acts as an internal analog to scientific falsification, noting that while computational verification aims for objective correctness, falsification focuses on the structural durability of theories against refutation.
detail.reason: Synthesis of existing evidence confirms the structural relationship between technical error detection and philosophical falsification.
